name: Revel Restaurant & Bar

evidence.note: OpenTable lists 'DJ on Thursdays & Fridays' and 'Dancing' as features; a Disco Brunch with a DJ says 'Come dance'; review summary mentions DJ and dancing.
Official site describes a bar and cocktail area in front of a large dining room in a 4,500 sq ft space.

dancing.notes: DJs play on Thursday and Friday nights and some brunches, and reviewers mention dancing. There is no separate dance hall, so people dance in the bar area.

description: A stylish restaurant and cocktail bar in downtown Garden City with global-style American food, brunch, private rooms and DJ nights at the bar.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Ira wrote only 'Revel'. Revel Restaurant & Bar in Garden City is the only Long Island venue named Revel we found that runs DJ nights, so it is the likely match, but we could not confirm a DJ Jolie booking there on Sat Oct 3 (OpenTable lists DJs Thursday and Friday). A DJ Jolie found online is an NYC-based event DJ. Owner should confirm.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Venue facts are confirmed (high confidence that this is Revel Restaurant & Bar in Garden City), but identityConfidence is medium because it is still not confirmed that Ira's 'Revel' (DJ Jolie, Sat Oct 3) means this place: the Revel site does not mention DJs, live music or a dance floor anywhere we checked (home, bar, announcements pages). Our current description mentions 'DJ nights at the bar' based on OpenTable; that is not on the restaurant's own site. Facebook: the site links facebook.com/RevelGardenCity; our current numeric URL (1374227202797949) is probably the same page. Logo is white on transparent (needs a dark background).
hours: Lunch Mon-Fri 11:30 AM-4 PM; brunch Sat-Sun 11 AM-2:30 PM; dinner Mon-Thu 4 PM-10 PM, Fri-Sat 4 PM-11 PM, Sun 4 PM-9 PM
